collectors.description: The collectors for which monitored devices should be used to identify and exclude duplicate IPs, if duplicate type is 4

groups.description: The groups for which devices should be used to identify and exclude duplicate IPs, if duplicate type is 3

type.description: What types of duplicate IPs should be excluded. Options are 1 (matching any monitored devices), 2 (matching devices already discovered by this scan), 3 (matching devices in these groups), and 4 (matching devices assigned to these collectors)

creator.description: The user that created the policy

collectorGroupName.description: The name of the group of the Collector associated with this Netscan

method.description: The method that should be used to discover devices. Options are nmap (ICMP Ping), nec2 (EC2), and script

collectorGroup.description: The ID of the group of the Collector associated with this Netscan

description.description: The description of the Netscan Policy

nextStart.description: The date and time of the next start time of the scan - displayed as manual if the scan does not run on a schedule

duplicate.description: Information that determines how duplicate discovered devices should be handled

collector.description: The ID of the Collector associated with this Netscan

ignoreSystemIPsDuplicates.description: Ignore system.ips when checking for duplicate resources

schedule.description: Information related to the recurring execution schedule for the Netscan Policy

collectorDescription.description: The description of the Collector associated with this Netscan

name.description: The name of the Netscan Policy

nextStartEpoch.description: The epoch of the next start time of the scan - displayed as 0 if the scan does not run on a schedule

id.description: The ID of the Netscan Policy

nsgId.description: The ID of the group the policy belongs to

group.description: The group the Netscan policy should belong to

cron.description: The cron schedule for when the scan should be run

recipients.description: The recipients that should receive the notification of the scan finish

type.description: The type of schedule. Possible values are manual (no schedule), hourly, daily, weekly, monthly

notify.description: Whether or not an email should be sent when the scan finishes
